# The Gemini app is now available for Windows

Sep 10, 2026

|

The new Gemini app for Windows lets you access AI help with a simple keyboard shortcut, directly from your desktop.

* * *

Erin Pettigrew

Director of Product Management, Gemini App

You can now download the Gemini app for Windows to get instant AI assistance directly on your desktop. Use the Alt + Space shortcut to draft documents, manage tasks, or create images without leaving your current workflow. Visit gemini.google/desktop to install the app and start using it today.

Summaries were generated by Google AI. Generative AI is experimental.

  * You can now download the new Gemini app directly onto your Windows PC.
  * Use the Alt + Space shortcut to get instant help without leaving your work.
  * Manage complex tasks and pull info from your Google apps in one workspace.
  * Create custom images and videos easily right from your desktop.
  * The app runs smoothly and won't slow down your computer while you work.

Summaries were generated by Google AI. Generative AI is experimental.

You can now download the Gemini app directly onto your Windows PC. It lets you use a quick keyboard shortcut to get help with homework or projects without leaving your current screen. You can also use it to create images, write summaries, and organize your files. It’s designed to run smoothly in the background so it won't slow down your computer.

Today, we're launching the Gemini app for Windows. Designed to work seamlessly alongside your favorite tools and daily applications, the new desktop app gives you instant assistance without breaking your flow.

Here are three ways you can use the Gemini app on your PC:

## 1. Access Gemini instantly with a keyboard shortcut.

Press Alt + Space on your PC at any time to open Gemini over your active work. Whether you need a quick fact-check on a document or a few catchy title ideas for a presentation, you can get the help you need and jump right back into your workflow.

## 2. Power through deep work in a dedicated workspace.

Inside the new app, you can access everything you use Gemini for already. Hand off multi-step tasks to Gemini Spark ^{1} , your 24/7 personal AI agent, or ask Gemini to draft a project summary by pulling information directly from your Google apps like Gmail and Google Drive.

## 3. Create images and videos.

Bring creative concepts to life directly from your desktop. You can generate custom images with Nano Banana for a presentation, direct a high-quality video with Gemini Omni ^{1} , and best of all you can do it all in one convenient place.

Lightweight and quiet, the app runs without slowing down your PC. This is just the beginning for the Gemini app on Windows, with more native desktop capabilities rolling out over time. The app is available today globally for Windows 10 and 11. Download the app at gemini.google/desktop.--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Microsoft announces quarterly dividend increase

## Annual shareholders meeting set for Dec. 8, 2026

1 minute

REDMOND, Wash. — Sept. 15, 2026 — Microsoft Corp. on Tuesday announced that its board of directors declared a quarterly dividend of $0.98 per share, reflecting a 7 cent or 8% increase over the previous quarter’s dividend. The dividend is payable Dec. 10, 2026, to shareholders of record on Nov. 19, 2026. The ex-dividend date will be Nov. 19, 2026.

In addition, the company announced the 2026 Annual Shareholders Meeting will be held Dec. 8, 2026. Shareholders at the close of business on Sept. 30, 2026, the record date, will be entitled to vote their shares.

This year’s annual shareholders meeting will be held virtually and hosted by Satya Nadella, chairman and chief executive officer; Amy Hood, executive vice president and chief financial officer; Brad Smith, vice chair and president; and Sandra E. Peterson, Microsoft lead independent director.

About Microsoft

Microsoft (Nasdaq “MSFT” @microsoft) creates platforms and tools powered by AI to deliver innovative solutions that meet the evolving needs of our customers. The technology company is committed to making AI available broadly and doing so responsibly, with a mission to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more.

# Introducing Microsoft 365 G7: Intelligence + Trust for the mission ahead

By Chris Barry, President, US Public Sector Industries

## Industries

  * US Government

## Tags

  * AI
  * Copilot
  * Microsoft 365

## Content types

  * News

The next evolution of Microsoft 365 for government brings productivity, AI, agents, security, identity, compliance, and governance together for organizations operating in Government Community Cloud (GCC) environments.

Across government, leaders are being asked to modernize services, address evolving cybersecurity needs, and help their teams meet growing demands simultaneously. AI tools can play an important role, but technology alone is not enough. Agencies need intelligence grounded in how they work, agents that extend that intelligence, and a control plane to help govern AI adoption securely. Innovation and trust must advance together.

Today, we are announcing the launch of Microsoft 365 G7, the Frontier Suite for government, to Government Community Cloud (GCC) environments. G7 extends the Intelligence + Trust vision introduced with Microsoft 365 E7 to government agencies, bringing together productivity, AI, agents, security, identity, compliance, and governance to support government organizations as they help accelerate mission outcomes and further mature their governed approach to adopting AI at organizational scale.

Both Microsoft 365 G7 and Agent 365 will be available for GCC customers to purchase on October 1, with capabilities expanding in phases. Customers can begin licensing, planning, and adopting available experiences at launch, with additional workloads rolling out as they complete required GCC authorization milestones. This phased approach advances innovation with the rigor government missions demand.

## Built on the trusted foundation of Microsoft 365 for government

Microsoft 365 G7 extends the Microsoft 365 foundation agencies know, starting with Microsoft 365 G5 solutions that bring together productivity and collaboration with information protection, security, and compliance capabilities. Microsoft Entra Suite builds on this with advanced identity, access governance, and network security capabilities for users and agents.

G7 is designed to support Frontier Transformation across the U.S. public sector by providing capabilities that agencies can use as they move from isolated AI experimentation toward governed adoption at organizational scale. It connects intelligence to the flow of everyday work, gives agencies a foundation for creating and using mission-focused agents, and provides the controls that IT and security leaders need to manage people, agents, data, and access with confidence.

## AI embedded in the flow of work

AI should make everyday work simpler, not create another destination. G7 brings Microsoft Copilot and AI-powered Microsoft 365 experiences into the applications government employees already use. Work IQ grounds these experiences in organizational data, context, and tools with governance capabilities designed to operate in accordance with applicable permissions, so Copilot can provide assistance informed by an agency’s work context and help users complete mission-related work.

At general availability, G7 will bring the value of Microsoft Copilot into a unified offering designed for government. Government teams can use Copilot to support research and analysis, find and synthesize organizational knowledge, and draft, refine, and collaborate on content in the Microsoft 365 apps and experiences they use every day. 

In the months following GA, G7 will also benefit from a surge of new capabilities rolling out in Microsoft Copilot across our US Government clouds, including the latest commercially available GPT models, Work IQ memory and personalization, Edit with Copilot across Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, and Copilot Cowork for longer-running, multi-step work. To learn more about how these advances can help public servants navigate complex work and support their organizations’ mission priorities, read our companion announcement on the Microsoft Public Sector blog.

## Agents at the mission’s edge

Agents can support specialized government work, from research and policy analysis to case management, grants, inspections, and constituent service. G7 provides an agentic foundation for government, with mission-focused agents grounded in Work IQ, and operating in accredited government clouds with policy-governed access for connecting to approved agency systems and data.

Agencies can start with Microsoft agents available in GCC, including Researcher and Analyst, and use Agent Builder to create experiences closer to the work. For specialized missions, teams can build custom agents with Microsoft Copilot Studio. Microsoft 365 Copilot Connectors bring agency knowledge from other systems within reach, while managed connections provide secure access to approved data and line-of-business applications. Natural-language creation broadens who can build, while organizational controls keep deployment aligned to agency standards.

## Agent 365: The control plane for AI adoption

The speed of agent adoption creates enormous opportunity, but without the right controls it can also create new blind spots. Leaders need to know which agents exist, who owns them, what they can access, and whether they are operating as intended. Agent 365 provides the control plane for agents in G7, helping organizations discover, register, and manage agents and take governance actions such as deploying, blocking, or removing them.

At general availability, Agent 365 will give organizations a unified foundation to discover, identify, and govern agents, with core controls to manage how they are deployed and used. Over time, we expect Agent 365 capabilities to evolve across security, risk management, and lifecycle governance. For detailed information about GCC feature availability, customers can refer to the Microsoft Agent 365 service description. As additional services complete required GCC authorization and readiness milestones, their status will be updated there.

## Advancing the mission with confidence

AI creates tremendous opportunity for government teams to build capacity, strengthen resilience, and respond more effectively to the people they serve. Realizing that opportunity requires leadership, workforce readiness, responsible governance, and technology that unites intelligence and trust.

Microsoft 365 G7 advances Frontier Transformation for government, giving agencies a path to empower employees, scale agents and adopt AI securely as capabilities expand. By combining AI in the flow of work, mission-focused agents, and a unified control plane, agencies can advance modernization with controls designed to support the stringent trust, security, and governance needs of public service and national missions.

Public sector transformation is about more than technology. It is about helping people serve communities and advance the mission. With G7, Microsoft builds on its longstanding government partnership to help public servants apply AI with the intelligence to support the mission and the controls to move forward with confidence.

Read our companion announcement on the Microsoft Public Sector blog

## Chris Barry

President, US Public Sector Industries

Chris Barry, President, US Public Sector Industries at Microsoft, leads the US Public Sector Industries division, encompassing the federal, state and local government, higher education, and defense industrial base sectors. His team of more than 3,500 sales and service experts is dedicated to driving digital transformation through Microsoft Cloud and AI solutions and deep, industry-specific knowledge to empower customers to achieve more. With over 20 years at Microsoft, Chris has held various leadership roles in sales and marketing, including Chief Operating Officer for Industry Solutions and most recently President of Microsoft Canada. He is passionate about building relationships, fostering diverse and inclusive teams, and driving organizational success.--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
